items.exampleEn: Each occupant of the building has a parking space.
items.exampleZh: 這棟大樓的每位住戶都有一個停車位。

items.exampleEn: The old story tells of a poor peasant who became king.
items.exampleZh: 這個古老的故事講述一個貧窮的農民後來當上國王。

items.exampleEn: Juvenile crime in the city has fallen this year.
items.exampleZh: 這座城市今年的青少年犯罪率下降了。

items.exampleEn: Many families in this town are of Dutch descent.
items.exampleZh: 這個小鎮上很多家庭都有荷蘭血統。

items.exampleEn: Every clan in the village has its own meeting hall.
items.exampleZh: 村子裡每個宗族都有自己的祠堂。

items.exampleEn: Most parents want a better life for their offspring.
items.exampleZh: 大多數父母都希望子女過更好的生活。

items.exampleEn: She felt a strong maternal love for the lost puppy.
items.exampleZh: 她對那隻走失的小狗產生了強烈的母愛。

items.exampleEn: The actress who plays the heroine is only sixteen.
items.exampleZh: 飾演女主角的女演員只有十六歲。

items.exampleEn: Cities offer lower taxes to woo new businesses.
items.exampleZh: 各城市提供較低的稅率來吸引新企業進駐。

items.sentenceEn: The two companies are trying to woo the same customers.
items.sentenceZh: 這兩家公司都在爭取同一批客人。

items.audioEn: The previous occupant of the apartment left a piano behind.
items.audioZh: 這間公寓的前一位住戶留下了一架鋼琴。
items.questionZh: 前一位住戶留下了什麼？

items.sentenceEn: The heroine of the novel is a young doctor in the mountains.
items.sentenceZh: 這本小說的女主角是一位在山區工作的年輕醫生。

items.sentenceEn: Most animals take good care of their offspring.
items.sentenceZh: 大多數動物都會好好照顧自己的下一代。

items.stemEn: The Lin ____ has lived in this valley for more than two hundred years.
items.stemZh: 林氏家族在這座山谷已經住了兩百多年。

items.stemEn: The book is written for ____ readers aged twelve to sixteen.
items.stemZh: 這本書是寫給十二到十六歲的青少年讀者。

items.passageEn: Last year, my cousin started researching our family's history. She discovered that we are of Hakka descent and that our clan moved to Taiwan about two hundred years ago. The first members were peasants who grew rice and tea in the hills. In her report, my cousin cites old letters and land records. One letter tells how a young farmer tried to woo his future wife by writing poems for her every week. Their offspring later opened a small shop in town, and the current occupants of that building still sell tea today.
items.passageZh: 去年，我的表親開始研究我們家族的歷史。她發現我們是客家血統，我們的家族大約兩百年前搬到台灣。最早的成員是在山上種稻米和茶的農民。在她的報告裡，我的表親引用了舊信件和土地紀錄。其中一封信講述一位年輕農夫如何每週為未來的妻子寫詩來追求她。他們的後代後來在鎮上開了一間小店，而那棟房子現在的住戶至今仍在賣茶。

questions.questionZh: 家族最早的成員以什麼為生？
年輕農夫怎麼追求未來的妻子？

items.promptZh: 我媽媽那邊的親戚都住在台南。
referenceEn: My relatives on my maternal side all live in Tainan.
All my maternal relatives live in Tainan.
rubricZh: maternal 表示「母系的、母親那邊的」（例如 my maternal relatives、on my maternal side 等）
「親戚」可寫，例如 relatives、family members 等
「都」可寫，例如 all（放主詞前或動詞前皆可）、every one of 等

items.promptZh: 飛機開始下降時，我們從窗戶看到了整座城市的燈光。
referenceEn: As the plane began its descent, we could see the lights of the whole city.
We saw the city lights through the window as the plane started its descent.
rubricZh: 「下降」用名詞 descent（例如 began its descent、started its descent 等）
「從窗戶看到」可寫，例如 could see…、saw…through the window 等
時態配合內容（例如 began、started 等）；過去式、現在完成式都正確

resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 題目改為「我媽媽那邊的親戚都住在台南。」
